decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.4183. Series context: trend strength 0.9729 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.423); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 25.752.
